name: performance-n-plus-one
title: Performance — product lookup per order line

pullRequest.title: Show product names on the order summary
pullRequest.body:
Invoices currently list a SKU per line, which support has to look up by hand.

Adds findProductById to the product data module and uses it from buildOrderSummary so every summary line carries the product name and category alongside the SKU.
pullRequest.author: marta-okonkwo
